blocks.title: DesignCraft in the activity panel
blocks.description: Spreads, parent pages and threaded text frames — the upstream DesignCraft publishing editor running inside Astravia, with the document you opened in the workspace.

showcase.user_prompt: Open DesignCraft and turn the background of @assets/cover.png into a blue gradient.
showcase.assistant_reply: Cover loaded. Turning the background into a blue gradient now.

items.title: The real layout engine
items.description: The tab runs the official DesignCraft web build byte for byte; upstream's wasm and JavaScript are not patched, and only two thin files of ours are added around them.

items.title: Open and export inside your project
items.description: Opening uses the file selected in the Explorer, and exports are written back through Astravia instead of landing in a downloads folder.

items.title: Ask for the current page
items.description: A capture tool saves a PNG of what the canvas is showing, and a status tool reports whether the editor actually finished starting.

items.title: Driven from the conversation
items.description: Ask in chat and the panel carries it out: pointer and keyboard steps run inside the editor one after another, each one named on the canvas while it happens.

items.title: Reopen what you were editing
items.description: The status bar remembers the last files you opened and takes you back to one through the same bridge the editor already uses. The upstream Recent list cannot reopen a workspace path in the browser build, so this list is the plugin’s own.

items.title: Install the plugin
items.description: The editor ships inside the plugin, so the first open is immediate and later opens need no network. after that.

items.title: Open the DesignCraft tab
items.description: Opening the tab shows the editor itself — no preparation screen, no package to fetch.

items.title: Select a document, then open it
items.description: File → Open inside the editor takes the file selected in Astravia rather than showing a system dialog.

items.title: Export back through the workspace
items.description: Exports travel the same bridge as saves, so the result lands where you chose.

blocks.content: DesignCraft describes itself as pre-alpha: expect missing features and changing files. The plugin runs whatever the pinned release does — it does not add layout features of its own.
Interface language: the editor itself is English only — upstream ships no other language. The tab shell and this page follow your Astravia language.

Automation is an ordinary operation, not a macro player: a batch is a list of pointer and key steps the editor receives exactly as if they came from a hand, paced by frames so a press lasts a press. The canvas reports a text map and its average colour back, which is how the agent checks that a change really happened before reporting it.
